status: deferred: author explicitly requested offline reanalysis and manuscript revision only on 2026-10-04; no paid calls authorized
model_rationale: One historical anchor plus the three endpoints requested by the author. Freeze selection before calls; do not replace models based on observed effect sizes.
shared_pass1: Generate once per item/model in the same collection window; retain the full assistant response and append exactly the same response to every Pass-2 history.
rationale: Generate both target stimuli anew from v2 inputs; freeze hashes before target calls; source-blind human validation is a separate required step, not automated prefix compliance.
sampling: Domain/label stratification, fixed source-document grouping. Pilot documents disjoint from formal test documents. Final N not frozen until pilot-based discordance, retention, and cluster-aware power calculation.
primary_test_family: Four estimands per model across four models: 16 hypotheses; Holm FWER .05. Report effect sizes and uncertainty regardless of adjusted significance. Cluster-aware inference design finalized before formal data collection.
stopping_rule: Fixed N and predeclared budget; never stop or extend to obtain significance.
decoding: Model-specific settings fixed after independent pilot; identical within each model's branches. No silent unsupported-parameter omission, fallback models or provider changes. Record actual served model/provider and reasoning usage.
retry_rule: Freeze before pilot; all attempts logged; no retry because an answer is unfavorable; no silent conversion of invalid answers to non-reversal.
budget_guard: Fail closed when the next reservation would exceed the approved cap, or any billed cost is unresolved. Formal experiment requires separate approval after pilot and power analysis.
